description: Fixed-range weighted fit and intent criteria applied only after hard disqualifiers pass. Every weight is an illustrative policy choice for a fictional ICP, not a validated model.

grade_thresholds.meaning: Work now: strong fit and active intent.
Work this cycle: good fit or strong intent, not both.
Nurture: partial fit or early intent.
Do not prioritize: weak fit and little intent.

criteria.label: Industry fit
criteria.rationale: Joint-heaviest fit weight (15): industry decides whether the offer's use cases apply at all. Unlisted industries get 0.2 rather than 0 because they are not excluded, only unproven.

criteria.label: Company size fit
criteria.rationale: Joint-heaviest fit weight (15): size drives deal size and whether a RevOps function exists. The sweet spot is 201-1000; larger companies score lower because sales cycles lengthen.

criteria.label: Revenue band fit
criteria.rationale: Weight 10: ability to pay. Lower than size because ARR is often estimated and overlaps with employee band.

criteria.label: Tech stack fit
criteria.rationale: Weight 10: an account already on the supported CRM needs no migration. A list scores as its best-matching entry; an empty list is a known 'no match', a null is unknown.

criteria.label: Region fit
criteria.rationale: Weight 5: region affects time-zone coverage only, so it is the lightest fit criterion.

criteria.label: Pricing-page visits
criteria.explain: {observed} pricing-page visit(s) in the last 30 days
criteria.rationale: Heaviest intent weight (12): the most direct first-party buying signal. Tiered so one stray visit does not count as much as repeated visits.

criteria.label: Hiring for RevOps
criteria.rationale: Weight 10: open RevOps roles show budget and an acknowledged gap.

criteria.label: Recent funding
criteria.explain_true: raised funding in the last 12 months
criteria.explain_false: no funding in the last 12 months
criteria.rationale: Weight 8: new capital usually precedes GTM investment, but it is a weaker signal than behaviour on our own site.

criteria.label: Champion job change
criteria.explain_true: a past champion recently joined this account
criteria.explain_false: no known champion at this account
criteria.rationale: Weight 7: a known champion shortens the path to a first meeting.

criteria.label: Open opportunity
criteria.rationale: Weight 5: confirms engagement, but kept low because the pipeline already tracks it and a heavier weight would double-count.

criteria.label: No incumbent competitor
criteria.explain_true: a competitor is already in use
criteria.rationale: Weight 3: an incumbent makes the deal harder, not impossible, so it costs a few points instead of disqualifying. A displacement motion could reverse this.
